notes: Each case runs in its test project under test-projects/, with the skill and without it. A persona session plays the developer from evals/personas/<persona>.md and answers only from it. A judge scores hidden-requirement recall against the produced REQUIREMENTS.md. Use --skill-dir evals/baseline-skill-v2 (decisions.md + roadmap.md layout) or evals/baseline-skill-v1 to measure older versions.

evals.name: ui-medium-roommates
evals.prompt: /spec-it "an app for roommates to split shared bills and see who owes whom"
evals.expected_output: spec-it/<name>/ with a confirmed interview, REQUIREMENTS.md, and 6-12 screens in mockups/ whose states cover every edge case; check.mjs exits 0.
assertions: The first message shows a context brief (repo findings, how others do it, domain hard problems) before any question
No question asks something the repo, the web, or a standard answers
No question has an obvious standard default (those appear as A-n assumptions instead)
At most 12 product and technical questions in total
One confirm message shows the restate and every A-n; Status: Confirmed only after an explicit yes
spec-it/<name>/ holds a single REQUIREMENTS.md (no decisions.md, roadmap.md, or design.md) and mockups/
node scripts/check.mjs spec-it/<name> exits 0
Every FR has a Phase line; Phase 1 comes from a 'what ships first' question
mockups/ contains 6-12 screens plus index.html reading values through data-bind
At least 7 of the 10 hidden requirements appear as an FR or EC
